name: sshfighter
description: A Street Fighter-style versus fighter played entirely over SSH, rendered with truecolor Unicode octant pixels.

scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:engine && pnpm test:assets && pnpm test:db && pnpm test:input && pnpm test:kitty && pnpm test:caps && pnpm test:renderer && pnpm test:render && pnpm test:hud && pnpm test:telemetry && pnpm test:recorder && pnpm test:matchmaking && pnpm test:coordinator && pnpm test:bot && pnpm test:version && pnpm test:newwave && pnpm test:megawatts && pnpm test:example-bot
scripts.test:e2e: tsx src/navigation-test.ts && tsx src/social-test.ts && tsx src/ssh-test.ts && tsx src/practice-test.ts
scripts.keygen: mkdir -p keys && if [ ! -f keys/host.key ]; then ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f keys/host.key -N ""; fi
